source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Why should you review a skill even when an artificial intelligence author produces polished instructions?

options.text: Fluent wording is the main evidence that every required step ran
options.feedback: Readable instructions describe work; they do not establish execution. Inspect tool and artifact evidence for completed steps.

options.text: Human review should judge wording before deciding the output requirements
options.feedback: Your expertise should make important requirements explicit before you judge the results, rather than letting polished wording determine success.

options.text: Clear prose can still omit task-specific quality requirements
options.feedback: An author can organize the instructions well while missing errors or standards that your experience tells you matter.

options.text: A procedure written by a capable model needs checking only for formatting
options.feedback: A capable author can still miss task-specific requirements. Review the substance and inspect actual results, as well as readability.
